name: OK-VQA
intro: OK-VQA 是需要图像之外知识的开放式视觉问答基准。研究者从 COCO 图像出发，经两轮众包、人工知识需求筛选、答案频率与零一致性过滤，得到 14,055 个问题；每题采集五个独立答案，v1.1 为兼容 VQA 格式将其各存两次形成十条答案记录，并由五人标注知识类别。
org: Carnegie Mellon University, Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
build_method: 随机抽取COCO图像, 两轮众包, 人工知识需求筛选, 答案频率与零一致性过滤, 五人知识类别标注
metric: VQA Score（十条答案记录留一法人工一致度；论文协议要求Porter词干化）
eval_feature: 外部知识, 开放式答案, 知识类别分解
build_method_en: Random COCO Sampling, Two-round Crowdsourcing, Manual Knowledge-need Screening, Answer-frequency and Zero-agreement Filtering, Five-worker Category Labeling
eval_feature_en: External Knowledge, Open-ended Answers, Knowledge-category Breakdown
intro_en: OK-VQA is an open-ended visual question answering benchmark that requires knowledge beyond the image. Starting from COCO images, the authors use two crowdsourcing rounds, manual knowledge-need screening, answer-frequency filtering, and zero-agreement removal to obtain 14,055 questions. Five independent answers are collected per question; v1.1 stores each twice as ten VQA-format answer records, and five workers assign a knowledge category.
scale_en: 14,055 questions; 14,031 images; 9,009 train/5,046 test; five independent answers per question (ten stored records in v1.1)
metric_en: VQA Score (leave-one-out human agreement over ten answer records; paper protocol requires Porter stemming)

drawio_review_note: Source-frozen review (reviewed_at=2026-07-18). The primary paper is arXiv:1906.00067v2 / CVPR 2019; the downloaded 17-page PDF has SHA-256 a2dd462304288311644a7ac96516c701eef4065845e80c5bcc8d940976f6ce6b and its arXiv source archive has SHA-256 89efca4f1afaa7cf8b642b223cb39f5adff1e268700c148944a07efff4640ec3. Sections 3–4 are treated as the construction and paper-evaluation authority. They disclose random sampling from the original roughly 80k COCO training and 40k COCO validation splits, preserving those origins as OK-VQA train and test; a first MTurk round in which workers write image-related questions intended to fool a smart robot and require outside knowledge; and a second round in which five different workers independently answer every image-question pair. Manual filtering removes basic counting/detection, questions answerable without the image, nonsensical questions, and questions that do not require knowledge beyond visual recognition. This reduces 86,700 candidates to 34,921 knowledge-dependent questions, but the paper does not disclose reviewer count, assignment, adjudication, or audit protocol, so the diagram does not invent them. Train and test are processed separately to remove questions whose most-common answer occurs more than five times; questions with zero inter-annotator agreement are also removed. The final paper counts are 9,009 train plus 5,046 test questions, 14,055 total, over 8,998 train plus 5,033 test images, 14,031 total. Five MTurk workers classify each retained question into ten defined knowledge categories, using the plurality label or Other. The fixed official project is https://okvqa.allenai.org/download.html and the downloadable v1.1 release is dated July 29, 2020. Direct inspection fixed the train/test question JSON SHA-256 values at 5a851aa3e6e83dec02903fc378212b240eec5b2294d0df4c257bb92fdfb300f0 and e0e0f7c86c83b4cefc435d1fd5276e1556d6751168c0a0fa3cf93f284e95cd1f, and the train/test annotation JSON SHA-256 values at edbb1a1a36d732fff3419ca81527d3987526a855cbf42f1c665ee28976e5a203 and 45bb566bd33c738873a1a5dcabd3e0bb6657a0a9b3048786148a0151a5d29df8. The corresponding zip SHA-256 values are afae4ffb3f612b2cefcf8ba1a6b0577af628782d8132cec0fcd2a42c12394d8f, 84756c5fcba1da8144c0bc1efd8a3075dc52ad5fa4aef39f56762dc578dbd58b, 2938f601e741f1c5ee8702350719fa720e9da7a00446bf1ac189c98a573bb575, and 6ef3c4d68bea516580c2090a05b4a4ca42e4d80e5469b04ca03fcb10b64b050d. These files confirm 9,009/5,046 rows and 8,998/5,033 unique images. They also resolve an important representation detail: five independent answers become ten answer objects because each answer is stored twice for VQA compatibility; this is not evidence for ten independent annotators. The JSON declares CC BY 4.0, while the underlying COCO images remain externally licensed. The official category browser payload has 9,009 rows and SHA-256 c5e83e89ab6041a5133438d6b4d44e0bd75a320da1fdb8837d83b39d32f144b4. The project exposes a public leaderboard and an official email-submission path, so has_leaderboard is true. For evaluation, the paper specifies the standard VQA leave-one-out score, counts each of the five independent answers twice, applies Porter stemming, and reports overall and knowledge-category results. The implementation boundary was separately frozen to the official GT-Vision-Lab/VQA repository at commit a013f0043c1e2cdc995922dfe257f7149aa9af06 (2021-03-11); PythonEvaluationTools/vqaEvaluation/vqaEval.py has SHA-256 f08edfcad5be0112500993e245c706b6cb928eadebe203f89f838e5e0d04bec8. That generic scorer normalizes whitespace, punctuation, digits, articles, and contractions, then averages leave-one-out min(1, matches / 3) agreement over ten stored records. The generic scorer does not apply Porter stemming to the prediction. In v1.1 the gold answer field is already stemmed relative to raw_answer, so the paper protocol and fixed generic implementation must not be collapsed into one unsupported preprocessing claim. The generic repository also does not bundle OK-VQA knowledge-category partitions or an OK-VQA-specific reporting wrapper. The source-stage diagrams therefore encode the disclosed collection, rejection, release, and score formula, and use a dashed boundary for fixed scorer, licensing, and category-packaging caveats; formal Draw.io/SVG/PNG assets remain outside this review stage. Formal publication evidence [site-a11y-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1885×865 (English) and 1885×865 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1883×863 and 1883×863. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
